items.rationale: The battery health waiver disapplies 2.6.8, so the laptop remains insured. Under 2.6.3 and 7.1.10 a repair the supplier reports as uneconomic is settled at the acquisition amount for an equivalent unit (photo shows a 15–16 inch aluminium MacBook Pro class).
Under 7.1.9 the difference for a higher specification is borne by the policyholder and is not indemnified under any head.
The tablet was struck in the same event, so it is a second unit under 2.6.4 within one insured event. The screen breakage is covered under 2.6.3(a) at a customary iPad screen repair rate.
5.2.3 reimburses examination of each affected unit, even where the repair proves uneconomic, capped at EUR 250 per event. Two diagnostics at about EUR 75 each falls under the cap.
Under 4.2.6 and 7.1.5 an undamaged accessory or carrying case is not an affected part, so its renewal is not covered.
Warranties and undertakings as to future performance are excluded by 3.5(f), 4.3(f) and 7.1.8(e).

items.description: Data recovery from damaged laptop drive
items.rationale: Data recovery is excluded by 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) unless additionally agreed. Nothing in the claim indicates it was agreed.
Under 7.1.8(b) administrative charges by any provider are not repair costs. The line also belongs to the excluded data work.
